one_line: Explains facial proportions using Anne Hathaway with bangs as an example before pitching an AI facial mapping app.

hook.what_happens: A split portrait asks viewers whether they prefer Anne Hathaway with or without bangs.
hook.why_it_works: Piques curiosity using a celebrity comparison and interactive question.

onscreen_text.text: Which Anne Hathaway look do you prefer?
Look at the space between her hairline and her eyebrows.
Without bangs, you see the full upper third of her face.
Add a fringe, and part of that space disappears.
Her actual bone structure hasn't changed.
But the proportions you perceive have.
The fringe frames her eyes, shifting where your attention naturally goes.
That's why the same haircut can look completely different on two people.
It's the relationship between the forehead, eyes, brows, and the rest of the face.
And if you've ever wondered what would suit your own face,
Refina's Facial Dossier maps how your features work together,
then shows you personalized recommendations and previews before you change a thing.
Understand your face with Refina AI

transcript.text: Which Anne Hathaway look do you prefer? With bangs, or without?
Look at the space between her hairline and her eyebrows.
Without bangs, you see the full upper third of her face.
Add a fringe, and part of that space disappears.
Her actual bone structure hasn't changed,
but the proportions you perceive have.
And there's something else: the fringe frames her eyes, shifting where your attention naturally goes.
That's why the same haircut can look completely different on two people.
It's not just the hair. It's the relationship between the forehead, eyes, brows, and the rest of the face.
Now look at Anne again. Bangs or no bangs?
And if you've ever wondered what would suit your own face,
Refina's Facial Dossier maps how your features work together,
then shows you personalized recommendations and previews before you change a thing.
Understand your face with Refina AI.

animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: Main facial portrait base images remain anchored.

Eye framing corner reticles for targeted visual callouts
